name: colony
description: Side pane showing agents as pixel creatures

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Freeze the pane to static frames and stop the animation timer

retentionSeconds.title: Retention seconds
retentionSeconds.description: Seconds a completed agent stays in the pane before it is removed

sessionsDirectory.title: Claude session files folder (optional)
sessionsDirectory.description: Optional folder of Claude Code's session files, read to show other running sessions as limited figures; leave empty for the default, <your Claude folder>/sessions, which is used while the sharing switch is on.

shareSessions.title: Share with my other sessions
shareSessions.description: Shares this session's agents with your other sessions and shows theirs, with full detail for sessions that share and a limited figure for the rest; off by default, so set it in every session.

sharedFolder.title: Sharing folder (optional)
sharedFolder.description: Optional folder where this session shares its agents; leave empty for the default, <your Claude folder>/colony, which is used while the sharing switch is on.
